items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: He had some first class musicians. And guys like Chu Berry, who was a great tenor player.

ctx.x: He had some first class musicians. And guys like Chu Berry, who was a great tenor player. Jonah Jones. But this guy that was playing these different notes, Dizzy Gillespie, I didn't know who he was. I just heard him on the air. I said, 'Who in the heck is that? Who the hell is that playing? He's picking notes like a guy picking apples off of a tree.'
